text.今も未来も心地よい暮らしとは、日本人がいにしえより大切にしていた、自然と調和した: A home that is comfortable now and in years to come is, we think, the home Japan has valued since long ago: one lived in step with nature. In a city apartment the natural light and moving air are easily lost. Our work is to give form to the courtesy and the sense of beauty that grew out of living with the seasons.
text.私共は、日本の風土に合った漆喰の壁や無垢材の床を用い、簡素ながら品の良いデザイン: We use shikkui lime plaster on the walls and solid timber on the floors — materials suited to Japan’s climate — and propose apartment renovation in design that is simple but well-mannered.
text.リフォームでしか創ることのできない「Timeless Living」についてお話: On the pages that follow we explain the “Timeless Living” that only renovation can make.
